scope: Frozen models on previously unused project source groups; original public Train provenance retained. Generated financial documents and manager replies are controlled conditions, not organizational effectiveness.

registration.scope: Frozen replication on every remaining mutually store/product-disjoint identity in the pinned source capture. No new training, model selection or reuse of existing Test cases. Financial documents and manager replies remain generated experimental conditions.
registration.selectionRule: Identity-only hash-order greedy matching of all remaining pairs; exclude every store and product from every existing split and prevent overlap among additions. Do not replace histories based on observed outcomes.
registration.primary: Actual emitted-order terminal loss plus request cost on complete seven-day periods, paired across frozen models; family bootstrap 5000 repetitions, seed 61. Censored periods receive only loss lower bounds.
secondary: Final parameter/state/evidence accuracy, necessary and unnecessary requests, response recovery, unresolved parameters and false handoffs on every registered financial condition.

All 33 rolling forecast origins for horizons 1 and 7; both aggregate and joint daily NLL, complete-period CRPS, interval coverage, identified full coverage bounds and order losses at cost ratios 1/3/9.
Report value-minus-checklist and value-minus-no_value with exactly matched constructor and GRU weights.
interpretation: This project has not used these source histories for fitting or model selection; the source publisher calls them Train. Preserve both identities.
Remaining greedy matches are a selected part of the source catalog, not a random sample of all retailer business.
Five disjoint weeks per source and seven generated conditions are repeated measurements; financial conditions do not add independent demand observations.
Complete-period selection and unknown latent demand restrict calibration claims; missing outcomes are not zero losses.
The existing generated Test threshold 240.35 has a different loss definition and is not applied to this retail cohort.
The selected model stays fixed throughout. Report all results, including unfavorable outcomes; do not tune or replace it using this evaluation.
